key.name: accent-mode
key.description: "fixed": the preset of org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color. "wallpaper": accent-computed, the colour taken from the wallpaper (VL3).

key.name: accent-computed
key.summary: The corrected accent of the wallpaper mode
key.description: "#rrggbb", written by the apply function of athanor-style. Empty, or not of that form, leaves the fixed accent in force.
